product_decisions.finite_supply: Freeze odds per published pack version; stop sales when any rarity is depleted; publish a new odds version to resume.
product_decisions.paid_minor_access: Wave 1 allows ages 13-17 to register, collect and redeem gifted cards, but blocks paid pack entry; do not claim guardian consent.
product_decisions.redemption_email: Keep recoverable address/code only in encrypted delivery data; resend the same still-valid code to the original address without extending expiry; delete all delivery copies no later than 180 days after the later of redemption or expiry.
product_decisions.tenant_notice: Use Hub and redemption-page banners, in-Hub/email for account holders, consent-scoped service email for unredeemed-code holders, and record notice events.
product_decisions.export: Include viewer-owned account/consent, groups, collection, draws and redeemed-code history; exclude other viewers and fraud signals; explain irreversibly anonymized omissions.
product_decisions.native_ios: Defer native iOS release, capture requirements and wallpaper export; retain portable React Native source and iOS Safari web support.

human_escalation: No local specification change incurs cost or touches production/accounts. Leave payment recovery/refund procedure unresolved; obtain human decision before production payment behavior.
limitations: PR body remains stale because editing GitHub requires the owner's account authorization.
Legal review is still required for age declaration, withdrawal-right copy, privacy notices and service-notice consent.
Operations choices for hosting, domain, email provider and legal entity remain open.
